jobs.description:

Key duties include regularly patrolling the exterior and parking areas to deter theft and trespass, monitoring the premises, controlling access, and responding to emergencies to keep everyone safe.

jobs.title: Night Security Officer: Golf Cart Patrol (2nd/3rd Shift)
jobs.description:
United Protective Services in Dallas, TX seeks a Security Officer for 2nd/3rd shift with golf cart patrol duties. The role emphasizes safety, security and strong customer service as part of a trusted team serving clients across Texas and Oklahoma for over 20 years.

Position is full-time with Saturday and Sunday 10PM–6AM shifts and a pay rate of $17/hour. Education required is a HS diploma or GED; a valid driver's license is also required. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance.

jobs.title: Night Security Officer: Perimeter & CCTV (Midnight–8am)
jobs.description: A major amusement park in Arlington is seeking a Security Deep Night Officer to conduct perimeter checks and ensure guest safety from midnight to 8 am. Applicants must be at least 18 years old and possess a valid Level II License. The role requires flexibility to work at both Six Flags Over Texas and Hurricane Harbor Arlington. The ideal candidate will have a positive attitude, comply with grooming standards, and possess strong teamwork skills.

jobs.title: Security Guard - Night Shifts (Armed/Unarmed) - 1099
jobs.description:
Security Solutions of Texas in Fort Worth is seeking a Full Time Security Guard to protect client property from criminal activity and trespassing. The role requires keen observation, strong communication, and the ability to stay calm in high-pressure situations.

Responsibilities include patrolling grounds, reviewing surveillance, controlling entry, enforcing identification, and coordinating with local authorities as needed. This is a 1099 contractor role with shift coverage in Fort Worth, TX.

jobs.title: Night Healthcare Security Officer – Protect & Assist
jobs.description: Dallas Regional Medical Center in Mesquite, TX is hiring a Public Safety Officer to safeguard patients, staff, and visitors. The role includes access control, patrols, emergency response, and incident documentation, with nights shifts from 11:30 pm to 8:00 am.Qualifications include High School Diploma or equivalent, State Guard Certification, and a valid state driver’s license with a clean driving history. Experience in healthcare security is preferred. Full-time, benefits eligible.#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs.title: DoD Security Patrol Driver — Night Shift
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer DoD Patrol Driver in McKinney, TX. This full-time, unarmed patrol position involves driving, monitoring, and safeguarding client locations across aerospace/defense environments with strong customer service and communication.

Minimum requirements include 2+ years security experience, active DoD Secret Clearance, valid driver’s license, and the ability to pass background and drug screening. Pay rate is $19.17 per hour.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Lead – Flexible Hours & Training
jobs.description:
United Protective Services in Frisco, TX, is seeking an Overnight Varied Security Officer. This part-time role offers $17.00–$19.00/hour with opportunities for growth into supervisory positions. You will patrol posts, document incidents, and deliver dependable customer service while mentoring newer officers.

The position requires flexible hours, strong communication, reliability, and a professional demeanor in a dynamic environment. Reports to Trevor Anderson and supports client relationships.
